assessments.reasoning: The Autoconf mirror preserves lib/autoconf/autoconf.m4 at 99a48ad6c1e3f446717e1f8fec2fb1ae76b09f2e with the claimed digest. The FSF-copyrighted driver identifies itself as part of Autoconf. Bytes 190–2512 contain the base election, output grant, data definitions and modified-version condition.

The Index’s pinned SCOPE.md, bytes 640–783, admits the FSF’s additional permission concerning embedded Autoconf text. The witness identifies the affected use precisely enough to distinguish the exception from a standalone license for the generator. Base-edition claims remain separately scoped.

limitations: The witness is a specimen of the form labeled 2.0. The notice prints no independent exception version number. Its base notice names GPL version 2 with a later-version election.
The finding covers this specimen. SPDX release correspondence, byte identity, formal template matching and application to another file require their own evidence.
reasoning: In the identified Autoconf 2.59 macro driver, the FSF permits copying, distributing and modifying generated configure scripts, including scripts containing Autoconf text. Other uses of Autoconf material remain under the GPL. This selective grant meets the Index exception criterion. “Historical” is an editorial state.
